Vaibhav Suryavanshi Becomes Youngest to Score Fifty in Duleep Trophy

Vaibhav Suryavanshi has set a new record in the Duleep Trophy by becoming the youngest player to score a fifty. He achieved this feat against the Central Zone. While he scored 8 runs in a previous match against the North East Zone and took two wickets, he excelled with the bat in the semi-final.
